landing.hero_desc: Attendance, grades, schedule, finance, and analytics — teacher-friendly and admin-precise. Bilim Nuru unifies your center's daily operations into one journal.
landing.hero_trust: No card required · Set up in 5 minutes · Data stored securely
landing.features_title: Your center's daily operations — fully unified
landing.features_desc: Once you're in the journal, work begins. No Excel sheets, Telegram groups, or paper notebooks needed. Manage from one place.
landing.feat1_desc: Attendance, grades, and lesson topics in one grid. Auto-saves; no conflict when two teachers edit simultaneously.
landing.feat2_desc: Attendance and grade dynamics per student, group, and teacher. Download Excel reports in one click.
landing.feat3_desc: Build schedules without room conflicts, with full visibility into teacher workloads.
landing.feat4_desc: Monthly fees, debts, teacher salaries — in one panel. Integrated payment gateways.
landing.feat5_desc: Every lead from your website is tracked. Source, stage, owner — all in one funnel.
landing.feat6_desc: Attendance and grades are sent via SMS or Telegram as soon as class ends.
landing.journal_desc: Monthly view, daily view, and student profile — three views, one journal. A teacher grades 18 students in 30 seconds with keyboard shortcuts.
landing.analytics_desc: Analytics at center, group, teacher, and student level. See at a glance who is falling behind and who is improving week by week.
landing.analytics_li1_desc: Charts update the moment attendance is recorded.
landing.analytics_li2_desc: Automatically flags students who missed 3+ lessons.
landing.analytics_li3_desc: View groups and teachers side by side on multiple metrics.
landing.testimonial1_quote: I used to spend 10 minutes writing in a paper notebook after every class. Now it's 2 minutes. My teachers stopped complaining too.
landing.testimonial2_quote: The "Was my child in class today?" calls from parents stopped. The SMS goes out automatically — I got my time back.
landing.testimonial3_quote: After the analytics section, we found in one day why so many students were dropping out of one group. Amazing.
landing.pricing_title: Pay based on your center's size
landing.pricing_desc: Based on active students. No hidden fees, cancel anytime.
landing.pricing_annual_note: −20% for annual billing · Special rates for public schools
landing.faq_a1: All data is stored on secure servers. Daily backups are taken. On request — full Excel export is provided.
landing.faq_q2: Can you migrate my existing Excel journal?
landing.faq_a2: Yes. Starting from the Start plan — we migrate students, groups, and payments for free. Usually takes 1 business day.
landing.faq_q3: Can my teachers work from a phone?
landing.faq_a3: Absolutely. The web version works fully in the browser; mobile apps are available for iOS and Android. Attendance can even be recorded offline — it syncs automatically.
landing.faq_q4: What's included in the SMS pricing?
landing.faq_a4: Carrier fees and templates are included in the subscription. If you need more than the limit, an add-on package is activated.
landing.faq_a5: Submit a request and a manager will reach out within 1 hour. We run a 20-minute online demo, answer questions, and can set things up immediately.
landing.cta_desc: No card needed. Demo with sample teachers included. Don't like it — just delete it.
landing.footer_tagline: Modern management system for learning centers.
landing.mockup_sms: Сардор бүгүн сабакта. Баа: 5. Тема: Past Perfect.
